intended_object: The bifunctor Rep k G × Rep k G → ModuleCat k sending (A, B) to the coinvariants (A ⊗_k B)_G of the tensor product representation with the diagonal action (from the docstring).
explanation: The body post-composes the curried monoidal tensor bifunctor on Rep k G (diagonal action on A ⊗[k] B) with coinvariantsFunctor k G, giving exactly (A, B) ↦ (A ⊗[k] B)_G, functorially in both arguments. It is stated for a commutative ring k and a monoid G, which is Mathlib's general setting for Rep and coinvariants. The docstring's remark about the isomorphism with A ⊗[k[G]] B (using g⁻¹) is only commentary and is not part of the definition. So the definition matches its intended object at the natural generality.
